what: Behind a long section a viewport-height photo panel is laid down, pinned to the screen while passing through the section, and only the photo of the cell nearest the screen center (text such as a course name) overlaps in with .8s ease-in-out — the new photo recedes from 1.05→1 over 2s ease-out. Before the section the first photo shows, and after passing the whole section the last photo sticks below the section

options.--fx-ease: Overlap curve, default ease-in-out — brand type is cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1) with --fx-scale: 1
options.lock: Time (ms) after a switch before it can switch again, default 100
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Photo panel (child) — inside it [data-fx-part=photo] in cell order (pairing can be set with data-index)
options.[data-fx-part=section]: Cells — usually one screen height each

use:
Course 1
Course 2
note: As in the original, the board is attached with position: fixed on window scroll. It is not used inside inner scroll panes ([data-fx-scroller]).

from.where: index.html .yf-course (course section — original .jsParallax: 16ms interval, section closest to screen center, 100ms lock, opacity .8s ease-in-out, topCourseZoomOut 2s)

index.html .product__body (Benefits section — original sticky-bg: three rounded photos at 38% width in the center swap by stacking over .8s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1) with no recede (--fx-scale: 1), and the caption under the photo rises 20px over .8s)
